notes:
Summary: mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics) evaluating Redwood for in-product AI assistant + support routing. Started with Hosted API trial (Q1) to validate prompt templates and embedding vectors. Now moving to Dedicated POC to validate latency under customer traffic and implement canary + fallback routing.

Highlights / quotes: 
- "Hosted API removed friction for devs; now need deterministic latency for enterprise customers." - E. Park
- Procurement: wants single-vendor SLA for critical feature.
- Engineering: moderate ops bandwidth; prefer Redwood-managed Dedicated with VPC and optional HSM for keys.

Technical requirements: 
- Workloads: chat/assist for in-app help, embeddings for search, reranking for results ordering.
- Latency targets: p95 < 120ms for short chat requests; p99 < 200ms under typical load.
- Throughput: ~120 concurrent users at peak; expect 50-100 reqs/s across endpoints.
- Model preference: open-family models (LLM3-family or equivalent) with quantized 8-bit variants for cost. Requires model-variant routing (full-precision fallback).
- Caching: prefix cache for common prompts; embeddings cache for document vectors.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown; per-route latency histograms; distributed tracing.

POC specifics agreed: 
- 4-week Dedicated POC (trial cluster in us-west and eu-west).
- Canary plan: route 5% traffic to Dedicated cluster for two weekdays after smoke tests; if errors <0.5% and latency stable, ramp to 25% then 50% over one week.
- Fallback routing: primary -> Dedicated cluster (model A, quantized) ; fallback -> Hosted variant (model B, region fallback us-east) ; final fallback -> smaller quantized variant in same region.
- Model variants: A = rwd-llm3-13b-q8 (primary), B = rwd-llm3-13b-fp16 (higher-quality fallback), C = rwd-llm2-7b-q4 (cold fallback).
- Region failover: us-west primary, eu-west mirror for EU traffic, automatic failover to us-east in cross-region outage.
- Rollback policy: immediate rollback to Hosted API for any sustained error-rate >1% for 15m or p99 latency spike >2x baseline.

Commercials & pricing notes: 
- Expecting Dedicated base fee + usage premium. Procurement requested committed throughput tiers.
- AE to propose two pricing options: (1) 12-mo reserved throughput + lower unit cost; (2) month-to-month burst with higher per-token.

Open action items / blockers: 
- Legal: finalize DPA + data residency clause (EU data routing).
- Security: confirm SSO/SAML integration timeline and KMS/HSM support for Dedicated.
- Engineering: provide sample traffic profile and synthetic load test script by 2026-03-18.
- Pricing: internal procurement to confirm ARR band by 2026-03-22.

Stubs/links: 
- Fireflies: ff_2026-02-18_3647 (intro), ff_2026-03-02_9921 (architecture deep-dive).
- Drive: pricing-deck.pdf, security-faq.md.

AE notes: strong technical champions (Evelyn + Staff ML Engineer Raj Patel). POC success criteria: achieve p99 <200ms under synthetic peak and successful canary ramp to 50% without error spikes. If met, move to procurement for 12-mo reserved Dedicated.
